beats.care: A deal could protect jobs in export industries like textiles and IT. A 100% tariff would make Indian goods far costlier in America.
beats.what: Marco Rubio said on Monday the US is very close to a trade deal with India. He meets Foreign Minister Jaishankar in Mumbai today.
beats.why: Last week Trump paused a law's tariffs of up to 100% on big buyers of Russian oil, including India, for a 60-day review.

cards.body: Rubio said the trade deal is one thing Trump weighs when deciding these waivers. He called India an important ally that has diversified its energy but still buys a lot from Russia. After Mumbai, he heads to Jamnagar, home to one of the world's biggest oil refineries.

India reportedly told the US its refineries are built for medium, slightly sulphur-heavy crude, the kind Russia and the Gulf supply. The Iran war has hit Gulf supplies, and US crude is lighter, so switching is not simple.
cards.title: why can't india just stop buying russian oil?

cards.body: The same law also allowed tariffs of up to 500% on goods coming from Russia itself. Both were paused together.

a.body: Rubio said you cannot unravel other countries' economies over one issue, and that energy prices and supply shocks justify the waiver.
a.label: US officials say

b.body: Senate Democrat leader Chuck Schumer and others from both parties criticised Trump's move to suspend the Russia sanctions.
b.label: Critics in the US say

cards.note: The waiver can be reversed, so India's relief is temporary for now.
cards.title: Is the pause good news for India?

opts: Cut it for a US deal
